title: AI News This Week: Gemini's AI Agent Goes Free + 4 More
description_intro:
AI News This Week #1: Google made its Gemini AI agent (Tasks) free in six countries, ChatGPT now types your words live while you talk, Google Maps plans whole trips, AI Mode in Search gets a private "temporary threads" button, and Gemini 4 Hydrogen speeds up Google's AI. Plus quick hits: Anthropic's IPO, Suno Visuals and Instagram's new repost protection.

Which one will you try first? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Subscribe to AI Daily Drop: AI News This Week every Sunday, plus new AI Shorts during the week.

first_comment: Quick poll: which update did you NOT know about before this video? 1) Gemini Tasks free 2) ChatGPT live typing 3) Maps trip plans 4) AI Mode private chats 👇

lines.say: This week, Google made its AI agent free, ChatGPT started typing while you talk, and Google Maps learned to plan your whole trip.

footage.q: Google official: Tasks in Gemini hero

lines.say: Plus, the company behind Claude just raised over eighty-one billion dollars by going public.
Here's what changed, and how to use it.
Story one. Tasks in Gemini, Google's AI agent, used to need a paid AI Pro plan. This week, it became free.
It's free in six countries: the US, India, Japan, South Korea, Canada and Australia.

graphic.label: countries get it free
graphic.note: US · India · Japan · South Korea · Canada · Australia

lines.say: To try it, open the Gemini app, and switch the toggle on the home screen from Chat to Task.

footage.q: Google official: Gemini Tasks text and email

lines.say: Then give it a long job, like analyzing a bill, shopping, or booking an appointment. It works in the background, and tells you when it's done.
Anything it buys needs your approval, and you can set a hard spending limit.

graphic.title: You approve
graphic.subtitle: Every purchase, with a spending limit you set.

lines.say: In the US, you can even text Gemini, or forward it an email. Google says Tasks can still make mistakes, so check its work.
Story two. ChatGPT now shows your words live, while you're still talking.

graphic.title: Live Dictation
graphic.subtitle: Your words appear as you speak.

lines.say: Before, you saw nothing until you stopped, and recordings cut off at ten minutes. That ten-minute limit is gone.
It's rolling out to every plan, including free, on iPhone, Android, the web, and the desktop app.
Just tap the mic and speak. Tap the waveform to show or hide the live text, and fix any word before you send.
Privacy tip: to keep your voice out of model training, find the setting called Improve the model for everyone, and turn it off.

graphic.title: Privacy tip
graphic.subtitle: Settings: turn off "Improve the model for everyone".

lines.say: Story three. Ask Maps, the AI inside Google Maps, can now plan a whole trip for you.
Ask for a weekend plan, and you get a day by day itinerary, with insider tips and a numbered pin for every stop.

graphic.title: Day-by-day plan
graphic.subtitle: Insider tips and a numbered pin for every stop.

lines.say: It shows live traffic, what's open, and the vibe of each place. Ask for a lunch stop or a viewpoint, and it adds one.
You can share the plan with friends, or export it to Google Docs on a computer.
In the US, it can also find appointments, like a four pm nail slot, and even call local businesses to check for you.

graphic.title: Finds appointments
graphic.subtitle: US first: it can call local businesses for you.

lines.say: And Ask Maps is expanding to thirty more European countries, including the UK, Germany and Spain.

graphic.label: more European countries
graphic.note: Including the UK, Germany and Spain

segments.title: AI Mode gets a private button

lines.say: Story four. Google's AI Mode in Search now has its own incognito button. Google calls it temporary threads.

footage.q: Google official: AI Mode temporary threads

lines.say: Click the temporary threads icon in the top right corner of AI Mode. There are no settings to change.

graphic.title: Top-right icon
graphic.subtitle: One click starts a temporary thread.

lines.say: Those chats aren't saved to your history, your past searches don't shape the answers, and they won't change what Google shows you later.
Close the thread, and it's gone. It's rolling out worldwide in phone and computer browsers, in every language AI Mode supports.
Story five. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is Google's new fast model, and it already powers Google Search for everyone.

footage.q: Google official: Gemini 4 Hydrogen key art

lines.say: Google says it finishes tasks two and a half times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash.
It also makes over five times fewer made up claims, according to Google.
In the Gemini app, it's in the model menu, and free users get it automatically when it fits the question.
It's also better at working with your Gmail and Drive, and it's the engine behind the Tasks agent from story one.
Quick hits. First, Anthropic, the company behind Claude, went public on the Nasdaq. It priced its shares at eighty-three dollars, and raised about eighty-one billion dollars.

graphic.label: raised in Anthropic's IPO
graphic.note: Priced at $83 a share on Nov 18 · Nasdaq: ANT

lines.say: Second, Suno Visuals turns your songs into short music videos, lyric videos and album art, with clips up to fifteen seconds. Visual credits are sold separately.

graphic.title: Suno Visuals
graphic.subtitle: Song to music video: clips up to 15 seconds.

lines.say: And third, Instagram now alerts eligible creators when someone reposts their Reels, so they can block the copy, or add an original by link.

graphic.title: Repost alerts
graphic.subtitle: Block copies of your Reels or add an "original by" link.

lines.say: Quick recap. Gemini's agent is free in six countries. ChatGPT types live while you talk. Maps plans your trips. AI Mode has a private button. And Hydrogen makes Google's AI faster.
Which one will you try first? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe to AI Daily Drop, for the AI news that matters every Sunday, plus new Shorts during the week.
